scope: Construction of one explicitly selected cast-in-place reinforced-concrete river-bank outfall headwall OF-RC-DN600-Q450-C3037 for a DN 600 outlet and 450 l/s design discharge. Approved 4.5 x 3.2 x 2.4 m geometry, C30/37 W8 F200 concrete and 28 m3 installed structural-concrete quantity are known scope; all other materials, work, QA, mechanisms and logistics remain direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved hydraulic and structural designer, geotechnical designer, concrete and reinforcement suppliers, construction laboratory and approving project engineer

material, earthwork, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from count or geometry coefficients
